m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What can I do fer ye on this fine day, my spell-slinging friend?
Oh, a Quicksilver Shield? Not a problem! I’ve got one right here... Oh, wait... I don’t. Are ye daft?!
Of course it’ll be a bit of a a problem! It’s not like I’ve got a brace of ‘em in me pockets!
If’n ye wants a Quicksilver Shield, ye’ll have ta help get me the stuff ta make it with! Quicksilver!
The only source of quicksilver is a runaway Steambot called Talos. He made off wit’ the last of our supply.
He’s hiding in one of the towers in the Crystal Reactor. I’d have dealt with the troublesome git by now, but I’m busy!
That was some piece of work! I’ll have yer Quicksilver Shield right quick!
That should do ye nicely! Take that back ta yer school with ye, and good luck!
Am I correct to assume you’ve done what I asked? Good.
Summoning the Medusa is not without risks, to be certain. You must be adequately protected against her gaze.
A Marleybonian fellow by the name of Engineer Montgomery once perfected a device called the Quicksilver Shield.
That will protect you from the Medusa, so you must have one before summoning her. But there is a problem...
Engineer Montgomery was with the expedition to Celestia, and he has not yet returned to Marleybone.
You must go the Research Station in Celestia and ask Engineer Montgomery to make you a Quicksilver Shield.
You must go to the Research Station in Celestia and speak to Engineer Montgomery. He can make you a Quicksilver Shield.
